column3: Went down the middle of the track - towards the back early - came under a drive and moved left to make ground over 2f out - closed on the front-runner approaching the final furlong - went to the front over 110yds out and kept going
Down that flank of the track and in the pack - made ground shifting left when asked 2f out - closed on the pacesetters 1f out under the whip - continued to the line - prevailed by a short margin
Down that flank of the course - sat behind the pace - came under the whip 2f out - soon edged in front by a whisker - overtaken over 110yds out and found no more towards the line
Down that flank of the track - made ground by the rail 2f out under a drive - driven and looked a big threat in the final furlong but couldn't quite get there

Down that flank of the track and in the pack early - made ground approaching 2f out - soon closed on the leading group and came under a drive - driven over 110yds out - found only one gear when short of room in the final stages
Down the middle of the track among the pack - came under a drive over 1f out - battled on but never enough gears to get involved
Down that flank of the track - towards the back - came under a drive 2f out and battled on - without gaining further ground
Down that flank in a good early position - came under a drive 2f out - weakened over 110yds out
Down the middle of the track among the pack - came under a drive 2f out - weakened inside the final furlong
Down that flank - towards the back of the pack - came under a drive 2f out - unable to land a blow in the finish
Down that flank - in front early - came under a drive over 1f out - soon overtaken and weakened
Down that flank sitting behind the pace - came under the whip 2f out - unable to make ground when hampered over 1f out
Down that flank - towards the back of the pack - came under a drive 2f out and faded
startled by a loose horse and unseated before the start - set the pace throughout but had company - driven along to a slender advantage into the furlong marker and stayed on strongly to the line
close to the winner - driven along and looking full of running approaching the furlong marker - stayed on but never got competitive to the line
stumbled at the start - settled in the pack - made progress 2f out - driven along soon after to close on the front group but found short of speed inside the furlong marker
stumbled at the start and settled in the pack - driven along 2f out - ran on unchanged to move into fourth in the final 110yds
up with the pace - driven along 2f out - faded over 1f out
dropped in behind - driven along 2f out - slight progress over 1f out
pulling hard early and settled in the pack - driven along and slipped back 2f out - unable to make headway over 1f out
dwelt at the start and pulling hard early - settled in the pack - driven along 2f out - faded soon after
Sat in behind the pacesetter and up to 2nd by halfway - went to the front beyond 2f out - soon asked for effort - ran on strongly in the final furlong to win

Sprung from the stalls and edged right early - raced close to the front group down the middle of the course - asked for effort 2f out and off the bridle in second beyond a furlong out - continued at an even effort in the final furlong
Towards the back - asked for effort out wide 2f out and up to 6th with a furlong left - ran on well in the final furlong
Sat close to the front group - asked for effort 2f out and off the bridle in 5th with a furlong left - continued at an even effort in the final furlong
Sat near the front group - asked for effort in 3rd with 2f left - continued at an even effort in the final furlong but was overtaken for 3rd near the line
Racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Towards the back - asked for effort 2f out without threatening and edged across to the right with a furlong and a half left - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Towards the back - asked for effort out wide 2f out - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Sat close to the front group - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - found nothing more beyond a furlong out
Sat close to the front group on the rail - asked for effort 2f out without threatening beyond a furlong out - found nothing more in the final furlong
Racing in the pack - asked for effort to make headway 2f out - found nothing more beyond a furlong out
Soon in front out wide - overtaken beyond 2f out and asked for effort - found nothing more in the final furlong
Settled early - asked for effort 2f out without threatening
Slow to begin - racing at the back throughout
Racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out and found nothing more
settled midpack down the track before moving over to another bunch 5f out - driven along 1f out - stayed on strongly to fight for the front in the final strides and got up narrowly at the line
travelled down the inner and moved to the front early - driven on 2f out - responded strongly in the final furlong - fought for the front in the closing strides but denied by the narrowest of margins
settled towards the back down the middle before shifting across to another bunch 5f out - angled left 2f out - driven along and made ground 1f out - stayed on in the final furlong

drifted left out of the stalls - handy down the middle before angling right to travel down the inner after 1f - driven along 1f out - drifted left inside the final furlong - found nothing more towards the finish
up with the pace down the middle before shifting across to another bunch 5f out - driven along 2f out - dropped away 1f out
settled in the pack down the middle - moved to travel down the inner 5f out - driven 3f out - dropped away 1f out
drifted left out of the stalls - in touch with the pace down the middle before angling right to travel down the inner after 1f - driven 2f out - drifted right and dropped away 1f out
dwelt and momentarily short of room at the start - settled towards the back down the middle before angling right to travel down the inner after 1f - driven along 2f out - faded 1f out
settled towards the back - denied room 2f out - driven and made late progress over 1f out - went to the front in the final furlong and ran on to win
raced in mid-division - driven 2f out - ran on in the final furlong to move into second near the finish
raced handy - driven into second over 1f out - challenged for the front 1f out - dropped that spot final 110yds - continued to the line
made the running - driven over 1f out - overtaken in the final furlong and quickly faded
sat behind the front pair - driven 2f out - faded 1f out
raced handy - driven 2f out - faded 1f out
raced in mid-division - driven 2f out - quickly came up short
settled towards the back - pressed for a response 2f out - not a factor at any stage
raced in mid-division - driven over 2f out - soon lost touch with the field and finished tailed off
Sat behind the pace - moving comfortably - was roused to go on 2f out and pulled clear - driven 1f out and continued firmly to the line - had matters in hand throughout
Racing among the pack - made ground over 3f out - shared third 2f out before sitting close to the front-runner under the whip over 1f out - kept on without ever looking a serious threat
Slow to begin - towards the back of the pack - made ground over 2f out then came under a drive over 1f out to move into fourth - drifted right and found only one gear in the final furlong
In front early - came under a drive and overtaken 2f out - weakened 1f out
Racing among the pack - came under a drive 2f out and kept on - without the gears to get involved
Towards the back - came under a drive over 2f out - battled on but always short of a threat
Racing among the pack - came under a drive over 2f out - unable to make meaningful ground
Stood up at the start - towards the back - came under the whip over 2f out - battled on without ever getting competitive
Handy in the pack - came under a drive over 2f out and weakened
Slow to begin - towards the back - came under a drive 3f out and drifted left - found nothing
Slow to begin - racing among the pack - came under a drive 2f out and faded steadily
Up with the pace - came under the whip over 2f out - faded over 1f out
Sat behind the pace early - fell back and came under the whip over 3f out - trailed off with little fight

pulling hard early and sharing the front - overtaken after 3f - driven along in pursuit of the front group over 2f out - made progress to hit the front into the furlong marker - stayed on well to prevail
settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - made progress into the furlong marker - stayed on to move into second in the final 110yds and battled on grimly to the line

quick into stride - handy with the pack - shared the front after 3f before being passed - driven along over 2f out - made progress to a fleeting advantage over 1f out - dropped back out of second in the final 110yds
pulling hard early and settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - stayed on inside the furlong marker to finish closest of the beaten horses
shared the front - went clear in sole command over 3f out - driven along over 2f out - overtaken over 1f out and dropped away in the final 110yds
dwelt at the start and settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - made progress into the furlong marker - ran on unchanged in the final 110yds
drifted left at the start - never a factor
pulling hard early and settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - faded over 1f out

Sat near the front group and up to 5th by halfway - asked for effort to make up ground 2f out - shared the front out wide with a furlong and a half left - edged in front inside the final furlong - battled hard to prevail on the line

Raced in behind the front group - asked for effort and edged left with a furlong and a half left - found a narrow path to launch a bid inside the final furlong - ran on to be denied in the final strides

Sat close to the front group and asked for effort in 4th by halfway - chased the front hard 2f out - soon shared the lead - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - ran on but came up short in the closing strides
Close to the front early - soon sat behind the pacesetter - shared the front 2f out - soon asked for effort but overtaken with a furlong left - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Sat close to the front group and up to 3rd by halfway - shared the front 2f out - soon asked for effort but overtaken beyond a furlong out - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Impeded at the start and racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Towards the back - asked for effort inside 2f out - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Slow to begin and towards the back - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - unable to quicken
Hampered at the start - settled in the pack - asked for effort 2f out without threatening
Drifted right from the stalls - racing in the pack - asked for effort by halfway and found nothing more 2f out
Edged right leaving the stalls and dropped towards the tail - shaken up 2f out without landing a blow
Soon in front and travelled keenly early - asked for effort and overtaken 2f out - found nothing more
Sluggish to begin - racing at the back throughout
settled towards the back - angled right and made ground 1f out before being driven to the front - stayed on strongly in the final furlong - comfortably
handy early - went to the front strongly 2f out - driven along 1f out - quickly overtaken - stayed on in the final furlong but unable to trouble the winner
pulled hard early - settled in the pack - lost ground for pace 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong - moved into third by the line without closing further
pulled hard early - settled in the pack - driven 2f out and made ground 1f out - drifted right final 110yds - found nothing more and was denied third close home
settled in the pack - driven 2f out - found nothing more 1f out
pulled hard early - in touch with the pack before being driven 2f out - stayed on without further improvement in the final furlong
dwelt markedly at the start - isolated towards the back before rejoining the field after 2f - made ground 3f out - asked for an effort 1f out - faded inside the final furlong
made the running early - driven and overtaken 2f out - dropped away 1f out
pulled hard early - in touch with the pack - driven along 2f out before fading 1f out
Led from the start - driven out with a furlong left - stayed on well for the win
Held up in mid-division - advanced into contention 2f out - shifted off the rail and driven for effort approaching the final furlong - up to second and found more close home
Raced up with the leaders - driven for effort 2f out - stayed on at an even gear to the finish
Raced close behind the leaders - driven for effort with 2f to run - continued at one gear to the line
Up with the pace early - dropped back 2f out and driven for effort - stumbled and faded in the final furlong
Started towards the back of the field - urged along with 2f to run - angled right approaching the final furlong - never got competitive close home
Raced in mid-division - driven along 2f out - soon struggling and lost ground
Settled towards the back - made a little headway 2f out and asked for effort approaching the final furlong - showed nothing further to the line
Raced in mid-division - faded towards the back 2f out - made no show under pressure
Settled at the back of the field - pressed along 2f out - made no impact in the finish
Raced in mid-division - driven along 2f out - soon off the pace and never in contention
Sat behind the pace - came under a drive to go on over 1f out - wandered left but driven out to continue firmly to the line
Slow to begin and drifted right early - towards the back - came under the whip over 1f out and made ground - up to second in the final 110yds but couldn't get on terms with the winner
In front by a whisker early - came under a drive and overtaken over 2f out - battled on at one gear
Racing among the pack - came under a drive and made ground over 2f out - soon close to the front-runner then driven over 1f out but found no more
In a good position in third - went to the front over 2f out - came under a drive but overtaken over 1f out and weakened
Hampered at the start - racing among the pack - came under a drive over 1f out - faded 1f out
Sat behind the pace - came under a drive over 2f out - unable to make ground when short of room over 1f out and faded
Keen to go and drifted right early - close to the front-runner - came under a drive and lost touch 2f out
settled in the pack - driven along and made progress into the furlong marker - stayed on strongly to hit the front towards the line
settled in the pack - travelling comfortably 2f out - driven along approaching the furlong marker - made progress to hit the front inside the final 110yds - overtaken towards the line
handy with the pack - driven along 2f out - eased off a true line to the left shortly after - stayed on inside the furlong marker - moved into third towards the line without further gain
pulling hard early and close to the front - driven along 2f out - ran on to a fleeting advantage over 1f out - finished on one level through the final 110yds
pulling hard early and handy with the pack - travelling comfortably 2f out - driven along to hit the front into the furlong marker - overtaken but finished on one level in the final 110yds
up with the pace - driven along over 2f out - stayed on inside the furlong marker
dropped in behind - driven along 2f out - stayed on inside the furlong marker to finish closest of the beaten horses
close to the front-runner - driven along to hit the front 2f out - overtaken over 1f out - ran on unchanged
settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - eased left but stayed on inside the furlong marker without threatening the front
settled in the pack - driven along over 2f out - faded inside the furlong marker
handy with the pack - driven along 2f out - faded in the final 110yds
in front but had company - driven along and overtaken 2f out - faded final furlong
drifted left at the start - settled in the pack - driven along and slipped back 3f out - ran on unchanged over 1f out
edged left at the start - never a factor
dwelt at the start - never a factor
Quick to break and edged left from the stalls - set the pace unchallenged out on the far rail - asked for effort 2f out and ran on well to win

Raced in behind the front group and up to 6th by halfway - made headway 2f out - asked for effort and narrowed the gap when hampered with a furlong and a half left - ran on strongly in the final furlong but could not get past the winner
Racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out to be 8th beyond a furlong out - ran on strongly in the final furlong

Impeded at the start - sat behind the pacesetter and disputed the front of the field down the middle of the course before being 2nd by halfway - asked for effort 2f out without threatening beyond a furlong out - continued at an even effort in the final furlong
Sat close to the front group and up to 4th by halfway - asked for effort 2f out - drifted left and off the bridle in 3rd with a furlong and a half left - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - ran on in the final furlong
Edged right from the stalls - sat close to the front group and up to 3rd by halfway - asked for effort 2f out without threatening beyond a furlong out - found nothing more in the final furlong
Sat close to the front group early - up in 7th by halfway - asked for effort 2f out and unable to quicken from beyond a furlong out
Settled early - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Settled early - asked for effort 2f out - unable to quicken from beyond a furlong out
Towards the back - asked for effort 2f out without threatening - unable to quicken in the final furlong
Slow to begin and settled early - asked for effort towards the back without threatening 2f out
Impeded at the start - sat close to the front group and up to 5th by halfway - asked for effort 2f out - found nothing more beyond a furlong out
Slow to begin and towards the back - asked for effort by halfway without threatening
Racing in the pack - asked for effort 2f out and found nothing more
Racing at the back throughout - asked for effort 2f out and found nothing more
led throughout - roused along 1f out - stayed on strongly to win with something in hand
pulled hard early - handy before being driven 2f out - moved into second 1f out - stayed on in the final furlong
settled handy early - driven 2f out - stayed on to move into third inside the final furlong
handy early - driven 2f out - dropped from second 1f out and faded through to finish fourth
pulled hard early - towards the back but not far off the pace - driven 2f out and looked inexperienced under pressure 1f out - stayed on gradually final 110yds
slow to begin - pulled hard early - towards the back but not far away before being driven 2f out - stayed on without further improvement in the final furlong
pulled hard early - not far off the pace before being driven 2f out - faded 1f out
Raced close to the pace - driven into second 2f out and went to the front in the final furlong - ran on strongly to score
Raced close up - went to the front 3f out - driven out and overtaken in the final furlong - narrowly kept second
Raced in mid-division - denied a clear run 2f out - driven along soon after - up to third final 110yds - came up narrowly short of second
Raced in mid-division - driven along 2f out - up to third with 1f to run before dropping back final 110yds - found nothing more close home
Settled just behind the pace - hampered 2f out and soon driven along - made no show in the finish
Pulled hard in the early stages - went to the front - asked for effort and overtaken 3f out - faded markedly with 1f to run
Showed signs of inexperience at the back - driven along with 3f to run - always adrift of the pace
Set the pace from the off - driven along and challenged approaching the line - prevailed narrowly
Travelled close to the pace - driven along with two furlongs left - chased the winner home and narrowly beaten into second
Sat third early - squeezed for space and dropped back three furlongs out - pushed along soon after - responded in the last furlong to retake third close home
Settled fourth - moved up three furlongs out - driven with two to run - drifted left inside the final furlong and faded
Tracked the pace early - urged three furlongs out - never got competitive
Settled off the pace early - improved three furlongs out - pushed along with two to run and faded soon after

settled off the pace - 5th halfway and made smart progress wide early in the straight - 3rd going strongly 2f out - driven and went to front 1 1/2f out then switched to rail - in command inside final furlong - stayed on strongly - comfortably
close up early and still 4th at halfway - driven into contention 2f out - overtaken 1 1/2f out then urged in second without threatening 1f out - stayed on at same speed
went in front over-fresh early - matched for a stride after 2f - driven and matched again 2f out - passed 1 1/2f out - urged in third 1f out - unable to threaten - stayed on at one speed
settled at the back - driven approaching 2f out - urged in fourth 1f out - unable to threaten and stayed on at one speed
close up early and pulling hard in 3rd at halfway - driven into the straight - 5th and boxed in 2f out - unable to threaten - denied room once more inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed
unhurried start - close up and shared the lead momentarily after 2f - settled into second - driven 3f out then urged in fourth 2f out - faded
Led throughout - driven out approaching the final furlong - challenged close home but stayed on top to the line
Settled towards the rear early - driven with a furlong to run - short of room in the straight - responded well to close on the winner but denied
Raced in the pack - driven with two furlongs left - closed strongly in the last furlong to move into third but could not get to the front two
Raced in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left - soon came under pressure and dropped away
Tracked the pace - driven and drifted left with a furlong to run - faded close home
Tracked the pace - driven to challenge the winner with a furlong to run - faded close home

close up early pulling hard - shared the lead for a moment after 3f before dropping to second - driven and went in front over 2f out - urged over 1f out - stayed on gamely inside final furlong - challenged hard in the final 50 yards - fully extended

handy early and 3rd at halfway - driven into the straight - second 2f out and soon urged - unable to threaten early in the final furlong - stayed on strongly and challenged the winner nearing the line - narrowly denied

towards the back in 9th at halfway - driven and made ground 2f out - urged in fourth over 1f out then 3rd 1f out - stayed on strongly in the final 100 yards - challenged for the lead nearing the line - narrowly denied
in the pack in 8th at halfway - urged into the straight - unable to threaten when denied room approaching 2f out - still 5th at 1f out - stayed on strongly going best of all
in the pack in 7th at halfway - driven and made ground early in the straight - 3rd 2f out then urged in fourth 1f out - found nothing more
towards the back of the field pulling hard in 10th at halfway - driven 2f out - urged in sixth 1f out - found nothing more
in the pack racing wide - 6th halfway then driven 2f out - urged and found nothing more
close up early in 4th at halfway - driven 3f out then urged 2f out - found nothing more
held up at the back throughout without threatening - driven 3f out and wide into the straight - urged over 1f out - found nothing more
close up early - 5th halfway then driven 2f out - urged and found nothing more
went in front then matched momentarily after 3f - driven and overtaken over 2f out - urged and faded
held up towards the back throughout without threatening - dropped away after 4f - still within range halfway - driven without response 4f out and faded
Sat third early - urged with two furlongs left - hit the front in the last furlong and ran on well
Settled towards the back - driven with two furlongs left - made headway with a furlong to run - moved into second close home but found the winner too strong
Sat second early - roused to hit the front with two furlongs left - overtaken in the last furlong and stayed on
Settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on but never got involved
Set the pace early - driven and overtaken with two furlongs left - faded in the closing stages
Led from the off - shaken up and battled on 2f out - asked for effort and in command final furlong
Close order early - asked to quicken 2f out - found nothing and beaten final furlong
Reluctant to begin and slow into stride - recovered to be handy approaching halfway - asked to quicken 2f out and found little - taken care of closing stages

close up early in 4th at halfway - driven in third 3f out - urged in second 2f out - drifted left then shared the lead when moving right over 1f out - went in front by a whisker inside the final 100 yards - stayed on gamely

close up early in 2nd at halfway - went in front over 2f out and soon driven - urged and drew level over 1f out - overtaken by a whisker inside the final 100 yards - stayed on gamely but outpaced by the winner

close up early racing on the inside and pulling hard in 3rd at halfway - still 4th at 3f out - driven when denied room approaching 2f out and hampered over 1f out - soon urged without threatening - back to 3rd in the final 100 yards - stayed on at one speed
close up early in 5th at halfway - driven 2f out - urged in third without threatening 1f out then 4th final 100 yards - stayed on at one speed
away smoothly and soon settled in the pack pulling hard - 6th at 3f out - driven into the straight - urged 2f out - found nothing more
towards the back and not involved in the finish - driven into the straight - 7th at 2f out - soon urged without threatening
went in front then driven and overtaken over 2f out - urged in fifth over 1f out - faded
slow to begin and towards the back - swerved off a true line after 3f - driven into the straight - found nothing more
in the pack racing on the inside - 6th at halfway - driven in seventh into the straight then urged 2f out - faded
Pulled hard in the early stages - sat third - driven to close the gap with two furlongs left - hit the front approaching the final furlong and ran on
Settled at the rear - driven with two furlongs left - improved into third inside the final furlong - fought into second close home
Tracked the pace early - improved into second after three furlongs - hit the front with two furlongs left - driven and overtaken approaching the final furlong but stayed on well
Sat second early - slipped to fourth after three furlongs - pushed along with two furlongs left and knuckled down to the line
Set the pace early - driven and overtaken with two furlongs left - faded close home
Led from the start - shaken up 2f out and driven out 1f out - held on narrowly close home
Close up early - asked for effort 2f out and drifted left - driven and veered further left 1f out - kept on strongly to be touched off close home
Held up in the pack early - found room and made headway 2f out to challenge for second - unable to quicken again final furlong
Close up early - asked for effort 2f out - lost place approaching final furlong
Held up at the back - asked to improve over 2f out - never troubled the front runners
close up early - 2nd shortly after 2f - driven and hit the front 2f out - roused and opened up over 1f out - stayed on strongly and comfortably
slow to begin and soon close up in 3rd at halfway - driven 2f out - soon urged without threatening - workmanlike in second when drifting right approaching 1f out - stayed on at one speed
went in front then driven and overtaken 2f out - soon urged without threatening - workmanlike in third approaching 1f out - found nothing more
settled within range in 5th at halfway - drifted left into the straight then driven 2f out - soon urged and found nothing more
settled within range - 4th halfway then driven 2f out - soon urged and found nothing more
drifted left leaving the gates and was sluggish to begin - soon towards the back - still within range halfway - driven into the straight - found nothing more and not involved in the finish
Tracked the pace - urged along and pushed into contention with two furlongs left - hit the front in the last furlong and narrowly prevailed
Settled towards the back alone - driven with two furlongs left - made up ground on the field in the last furlong - finished full of running into second but narrowly beaten
Went to the front early - urged with two furlongs left - overtaken approaching the final furlong but stuck to task without quickening
Sat behind the pace-setters - roused and improved to hit the front with a furlong to run - overtaken in the final furlong and faded
Sat behind the pace-setters - driven with two furlongs left - faded soon after
Towards the back early - moved out and made progress over 2f out - challenged strongly for the advantage over 1f out - went in front close home and pulled away in the final strides
Set the pace - driven inside 2f out when pressed - continued to fight on 1f out - drifted left and lost the advantage close home with nothing more to offer
Handy in second early - driven hard over 2f out and started to drop away - beaten from over a furlong out
Edged right at the off - held up at the back - never a threat
Sluggish start but over-eager and up with the leading duo - shifted left and asked to quicken over 2f out yet drifted right without response - faded approaching the final furlong

close up early racing on the inside in 7th at halfway - driven momentarily into the straight - made ground into third 2f out - went in front 1 1/2f out then urged and challenged hard 1f out - stayed on gamely in the final 150 yards

in the pack racing wide in 6th at halfway - drifted left into the straight - driven and made ground 2f out - urged in second over 1f out and pressed for the lead 1f out - unable to threaten in the final 150 yards and stayed on at one speed
towards the back in 9th on the outer at halfway - driven and moved right 2f out - urged without threatening over 1f out - 5th approaching 1f out then stayed on at one speed - 3rd nearing the line
in the pack in 8th at halfway - driven 2f out - urged and drifted right 1 1/2f out - 3rd 1f out without threatening - stayed on at one speed - 4th nearing the line
close up early - driven in fifth halfway - urged when bumped 1 1/2f out then soon drifted right - 4th without threatening approaching 1f out - stayed on at one speed
towards the back of the pack racing wide - driven in eleventh 2f out then soon denied room - urged and stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong
close up early travelling keenly in 4th at halfway - racing wide into the straight and soon driven - urged without threatening over 1f out - faded
up with the pace and went in front after 2f - drifted left into the straight - overtaken 2f out - soon driven and faded
up with the pace and close up in the front rank after 2f - driven 2f out - soon urged and faded
slow to begin and in the pack on the inside - driven 2f out - without threatening when hampered over 1f out - found nothing more
held up at the back throughout and not involved in the finish - urged approaching 2f out - found nothing more
up with the pace and close up with the front pair after 1 1/2f in 3rd at halfway - went in front 2f out - urged and overtaken 1 1/2f out - faded
in the pack - driven and slipped towards the back after 2f - urged 2f out - found nothing more and not involved in the finish
in the pack racing wide - driven towards the back halfway then faded 2f out - allowed to coast home
In front by a short margin early - overtaken and tracked the pace-setter - travelling strongly with two furlongs left - driven back in front approaching the final furlong and ran on bravely
Settled towards the back - driven with two furlongs left - improved to close on the winner with a furlong to run and stayed on strongly
Raced behind the pace-setter - driven with two furlongs left - hit the front for a moment with a furlong to run before being overtaken - found nothing more in the closing stages
Settled towards the back - driven with a furlong to run - kept on without gaining further ground
Struggled for pace early towards the back - driven three furlongs out - never got competitive with the front runners
Broke poorly and short of room early - went on to hit the front after a furlong - overtaken with a furlong to run and faded fast
Led throughout - asked for effort 2f out - kept finding more and untroubled to the line
